entries.note: Independent audit (not the translator) of cli.vault at source hash 88cd0862f4e2: 24/24 keys present in en order; ICU placeholder names/kinds parity with en ({endpoint}, {org}, {minutes}, {until}, {url}); every backticked command (`lop vault connect`, `lop login radient`, `lop team-bridge setup`) byte-identical; Ctrl+C, Radient Vault, Radient Team, Local Operator, JSON and 600 kept verbatim; {url} stays last in revoke_hint; NFC, no bidi/zero-width controls; repo check.py --catalogues-only 0 problems.
